description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy of several different methods—DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, and PPO—across three datasets: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis represents the datasets, labeled “Mathverse”, “MMLU”, and “Physics” in that order, with no apparent sorting. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 50 to 62, with tick marks at intervals of 2. For each dataset, there are five bars representing the accuracy of each method. The “DAPO+Self-reflection” method is represented by a blue bar, “DAPO” by an orange bar with diagonal stripes, “SRPO” by a solid orange bar, “GRPO” by a light-brown bar with diagonal stripes, and “PPO” by a green bar. In Mathverse, the bar heights are approximately 52.8 for PPO, 53.8 for GRPO, 54.4 for DAPO, 55.3 for SRPO, and 56.2 for DAPO+Self-reflection. In MMLU, the bar heights are approximately 54.7 for PPO, 55.3 for GRPO, 56.1 for DAPO, 56.8 for SRPO, and 57.2 for DAPO+Self-reflection. In Physics, the bar heights are approximately 57.3 for PPO, 58.1 for GRPO, 58.6 for DAPO, 59.4 for SRPO, and 60.4 for DAPO+Self-reflection. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
